test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in bold in the following sentence.**

I broke away from their **solicitous **grip.
solution:
The correct answer is: **heedless**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Solicitous means showing care and helpful attention to someone. (किसी की देखभाल और मददगार ध्यान दिखाना)

 
 
• Example -* He made a solicitous enquiry after her health.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Heedless **means showing a reckless lack of care or attention. (देखभाल या ध्यान की लापरवाह कमी दिखा रहा है)
 
 
• Example -* Heedless of the hurricane warnings, they took the small boat out into open water.*
 
 
 
• It is clear that 'Solicitous' and 'Heedless' are opposite in meaning.

Therefore the correct answer is option 2.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Worried **means anxious or troubled about actual or potential problems. (वास्तविक या संभावित समस्याओं के बारे में चिंतित या परेशान)
 
• **Knowledgeable **means intelligent and well informed. (बुद्धिमान और अच्छी तरह से सूचित)
 
• **Interesting **means engaging or exciting and holding the attention or curiosity. (आकर्षक या रोमांचक और ध्यान या जिज्ञासा को पकड़ना)
